rationale: Luke's work on AI-powered adaptive learning and generative video at Infinity AI Institute complements Shiza's hands-on approach to building frontier AI systems — she's gone from biomedical imaging research to humanoid robotics subsystems, while Luke is exploring how knowledge graphs and AI-generated courses can transform education. Both share a conviction that meaningful problems get solved through direct building and proximity to smart people, and both have shipped across multiple ML domains (computer vision, LLM tooling, robotics), making them natural collaborators on AI products that bridge learning, perception, or embodied systems.
intro_message: Luke Bechtel, meet Shiza Charania — you're both hands-on builders shipping AI across multiple domains (generative video + adaptive learning vs. robotics + computer vision), and you both believe the fastest way to solve hard problems is building directly at the frontier with smart people.
